name: 92591 · Temecula, CA
findings: ZIP 92591 (Temecula) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92591 (Temecula) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
